material_deltas.fact: At the deadline the submitted form and linked repository, video, live site, and other project materials lock and must remain unchanged until winners are announced.
material_deltas.impact: Freeze the judged candidate and move post-competition work to a separate branch or copy.

material_deltas.fact: The public video must be at most four minutes, in English or fully English-subtitled, show the agent actually working, and visibly prove the backend ran on Google Cloud.
material_deltas.impact: The final video cannot be recorded without real Gate 7 proof.

material_deltas.fact: A repository URL, architecture diagram upload, and step-by-step README spin-up guide are explicit submission checklist items.
material_deltas.impact: Repository publication is mandatory; the architecture and spin-up guide are already prepared.

material_deltas.fact: A hosted-project URL is highly encouraged when available, but the application need not remain publicly running during submission or judging if strict Google Cloud deployment proof is captured.
material_deltas.impact: Capture the Cloud Run URL and console/log proof; do not fabricate continuous availability.

material_deltas.fact: The separate 150-dollar hackathon Google Cloud credit allocation is exhausted; the Google Cloud free trial is a distinct route.
material_deltas.impact: Do not wait for or re-request hackathon credits. Current free-trial readiness remains unobservable from Work.

material_deltas.fact: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform products are recommended for Fortified Enterprise Fleet and may earn bonus value, but are not mandatory; Gemini 3.5+, one Google agent framework, and one Google Cloud infrastructure service remain mandatory.
material_deltas.impact: Keep the verified application-level fortified controls; do not add risky optional managed products before mandatory closure.
